driver: A coverage share is struck on a weighting recovered from a closed corpus of past determinations and on a clock that drops only the interruption types a zero-activity behavioural test shows truly blocked use, which the corpus cannot see because none of its cases carries the interruption, so the back-tested weighting alone overshoots the dial.
driver_concrete: Clearance is struck equal-weighted across 40 client groups (the only basis reproducing all 32 published allowances) on available nights, dropping only hold nights under CERT-PEND, LOTREC-CHK and PKG-REV (zero despatch lines across 630 spans), which moves the 90.0 per cent crossing from day 47 (56 days) to day 32 (35 days).
stump: A competent solver back-tests the 32 published allowances, recovers client-group weighting 32 of 32 and files 56 days on nights on hand, because none of the sixteen published families carries release holds; one who reads the availability clause and removes every hold night files 28.
